caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain light background. The object consists of a horizontally oriented cylindrical handle at the top, which is tan in color with slightly flared ends and carved decorative lines, including a diamond-shaped crosshatch pattern in the middle section. At the center of the handle, there is a small round knob. Attached to the handle is a vertical, dark metallic shaft with a slight curve and taper. At the bottom, the shaft ends with an old-fashioned, large key bit, also dark in color, featuring a rectangular bow and notched end. In the lower right corner of the image, the name "Adele Brooks." appears handwritten in small, neat letters.
title: Tooth Key (or Tooth Extractor)
